title: Police Working Conditions Welfare and Shift Reform Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal mandating an 8-hour shift system for police officers, 1 mandatory rest day per week, annual mental health screening, and statutory housing/healthcare entitlements.
notes: Matter 021: Police Working Conditions Welfare and Shift Reform Bill, 2026.
